Title: Starting This Journal
Summary: Why I'm finally putting my process and thoughts somewhere public.
Body:
I've had a habit of finishing a piece and immediately moving on, never really sitting with it.
This journal is my attempt to slow that down a little — writing about the process, not just posting the result.
